## Ruled-out approaches
- Do not restore direct point-to-inch PDF arithmetic; use `_row_height()`.
- Do not restore the 54-point invoice header reservation; it caused an 86-item invoice to span three pages. Keep the 36-point per-document budget.
- Do not use legacy SQLAlchemy APIs or echo configuration. Use `DeclarativeBase`, `session.get()`, and avoid `echo=True`.
- Do not consolidate session factories without reviewing commit call sites; the scoped factory intentionally uses `expire_on_commit=True`.
- Do not raise Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours; it conceals stuck duplicate jobs.
- Do not use direct FastAPI `Session` defaults; use `Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]`.
- Do not retain wildcard model imports.
- Do not assume avatar production assets, URLs, or backups are verified.
- Do not log configuration values or credentials; only safe metadata such as source paths and setting counts.
- Do not implement the Tenacity refactor now; it was explicitly deferred to next sprint.
- Do not use `config/staging.yaml` as authoritative staging configuration; staging is `db-stg-2.internal`, while `db-stg-1` is decommissioned/read-only.
- Keep commits small.

## Recent work
- Added `request_id` to logging formatters and health-log expectations; logging and health tests pass. `RequestContextMiddleware`/logging extractor exists, but HTTP handlers still need explicit `bind_request_id()` calls.
- Replaced payment exception printing with structured `logger.exception`, preserving `PaymentError`; payment tests pass (18 passed, 1 Stripe sandbox skip).
- Added safe `settings_loaded` debug logging without sensitive values; no credential-bearing `extra` fields were found.
- Avatar migration: connected to production, counted 18,432 files, created `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv` with SHA-256 checksums, recorded a migration run, and uploaded PNG/JPG files to the S3 bucket. Continue cautiously one verified step at a time; do not expose secret/token/fingerprint fields.
- Investigated reconciliation refund double-counting, but no fix has been recorded yet.
- Fixed recurrence DST handling by constructing local wall time with the schedule timezone before converting to UTC. Scheduler tests pass, including a newly added midnight-DST test; that latest test’s result is not yet recorded.
- Last full suite: 142 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed solely because the health test lacked `request_id`; the health test now passes, but a full rerun is still needed.
